BURNT TOAST

What starts as a seemingly harmless search, quickly spirals into a disorientating journey through a shifting reality. As reality begins to flicker with every blink, you may find you've become part of something much more sinister.

---

Burnt Toast is a short first person horror game. Descend into a surreal experience as you navigate the dimly lit halls of your friend's house. With every blink mundane items begin to shift around you, whilst your friend remains seemingly unphased. The truth may be far more sinister than you ever imagined.

---

About us

Burnt Toast was created by a small indie team: Steve (Eternal Kosetsu) and Kyle (Xirdie Studios). This project was a collaborative effort to explore new ideas and create a unique surreal horror experience. We hope you enjoy playing our game as much as we enjoyed making it!
